before.title: Before
before.description: Everything starts with preparation. Are you signed onto Wikipedia, have you uploaded your profile pic to Wikimedia Commons, and made sure your team can see your badge before the meeting begins.

page.label: PHASE ONE / BEFORE THE EVENT
page.title: Planning to Wikify
page.lead: The earlier you can plan your Wikifying event, the better. Preparation makes it easier to work with sponsors, to identify people and subjects of interest, prepare Wikimedia, and make the most of your time together.

cards.title: Plan
cards.description: Choose the event, consider timing and location, arrange travel and accommodation funding, and determine how many people you will need.

cards.title: Organisers
cards.description: Pitch the value of having a Wikimedian present. Discuss tables, badges, registration, workshops, posters and conference communications.

cards.title: Communications
cards.description: Confirm your space, attendee information, permissions, photography arrangements and how Wikimedia participation will be publicised.

cards.title: Wikidata
cards.description: Prepare the conference item, organisers, speakers, participants, awards and relevant identifiers before arriving.

cards.title: Commons
cards.description: Create event categories, identify people who need photographs and prepare structured data for uploads.

cards.title: Engage Early
cards.description: Contact priority attendees, arrange meetings, promote your presence and make sure participants know what the Wikimedia team will be doing.

during.title: During
during.description: Connect with people at the meetup, try to document the event, photograph participants and create meaningful Wikimedia relationships.

page.label: PHASE TWO / DURING THE EVENT
page.title: During the Event
page.lead: Meet researchers, document the conference, collect photographs and build relationships with specialists and Wikimedia communities.

after.title: After
after.description: Process the photographs, improve Wikidata, share outcomes and turn conference connections into lasting collaboration.

page.label: PHASE THREE / AFTER THE EVENT
page.title: After the Event
page.lead: Process photographs, improve Wikidata, document the outcomes and turn conference connections into lasting collaboration.
